items.label: Heavy rain on wet ground
items.definition: A day with at least 27.902 mm rain (wet-day p95) after a day with top-soil wetness at or above 0.76 (p75).

items.label: Multi-day heavy rain
items.definition: 3 days in a row totalling at least 41.9 mm (1.5 x the heavy-rain day, assumed).

items.label: Dry spell
items.definition: At least 10 days in a row with less than 1.0 mm rain (assumed).
